definition: Every admissible candidate has another admissible candidate of strictly greater quality under the fixed order. This rules out a greatest quality achieved by an admissible candidate. Nat with all values admissible and identity quality is a concrete witness; Aquinas q25a6 is not asserted to establish this universal condition.
note: Analyst-defined diagnostic for the selected-effect frontier. Not a historical attribution or independently established metaphysical premise. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md.
